script.title: Ordinary vs Special Resolution
script.caption_hook: Resolutions pass on votes cast, not on how many members exist!

lines.say: Wait, a resolution passes by counting votes, not members?
Yes! Only votes actually cast count. Let's see two types: ordinary and special.
Ordinary needs more votes for than against. Just one more vote wins.

board.title: Ordinary Resolution
board.sub: Votes cast in person, proxy or online

lines.say: Okay, what if many members don't even vote?
They're ignored. Abstaining members cast no vote, so they're in neither count.
For-votes must be at least three times the votes against. Think three to one.

board.title: Special Resolution
board.sub: Notice must say it is special

lines.say: Can you give a quick example?
Say 60 votes for, 20 against. Three times twenty is sixty, so it passes.
What if it's 50 for and 20 against?
Fifty is less than sixty, so it fails as special. But as ordinary, it passes.
Oh! When do we use which one?
Routine matters, like declaring dividend, need ordinary. Altering articles needs special, and the notice must say so.
Remember: ordinary is one more, special is thrice.

check_notes: Writer: Word count is about 156. The 50 for / 20 against example passes as ordinary (50 > 20) and fails as special (needs 60).
Checker: Hook stamp: 'COUNT VOTES, NOT' is cut off mid-phrase. Finish it, e.g. 'COUNT VOTES, NOT MEMBERS', to match Line 1.

Checker: Line 4 / Line 15 ('Just one more vote wins', 'Ordinary: One more'): the rule is wording-only shaky. Section 114(1) only requires votes for to exceed votes against, and the chairman's casting vote (if any) is included. Suggest: 'Votes for must exceed votes against, even by one, including any casting vote of the chairman.'

Checker: Line 4 board sub: 'Votes cast in person, proxy or online' leaves out some voting modes. Section 114 covers show of hands, electronic voting, poll and postal ballot, in person or by proxy. Suggest: 'Votes cast by show of hands, poll, e-voting or postal ballot, in person or by proxy'.
Checker: Line 2 / Line 6: say that only votes cast by members entitled to vote are counted. Suggest: 'Only votes actually cast by members entitled to vote count.'
